description: Search the Picnic supermarket for a product and get its id for add_to_cart. Write the query in Dutch, as a short product name. The result has `bestMatch` when one product fits, usually one the user bought before: add that one. It has `choices` when there is no clear match: ask the user which one they want before adding anything. `boughtBefore` marks products the user ordered before.

query.description: The product to search for, in Dutch.

name: search_products
title: Search products
